Subject: Juniver Warehousing - Referral Required

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the submission on Juniver Warehousing.

I've reviewed the risk and need to refer this to our senior underwriting team for approval due to the following:

- Three locations are within 16 km of the coast
- Our existing coastal exposure is already high in this area (significant portfolio accumulation within 25 km)

Before I can move this forward, I need answers to these questions:

1. What specific wind mitigation features are in place at each location (roof ratings, opening protections, etc.)?
2. Are all buildings non-combustible construction?
3. What percentage of the TIV is within 5 km of the coast vs. 5-16 km?

If our capacity is limited due to accumulation concerns, you may want to consider approaching specialty coastal markets for competitive terms.

I'll follow up once I hear back.

Best,
[Underwriter name]
